valid.active-partial-commit.json: Active protective state over one exact work record.
valid.released-after-repair.json: Release through a new immutable revision with exact repair operation evidence.
valid.superseded-by-narrower-quarantine.json: Supersession through a new immutable revision and exact successor reference.

invalid.active-with-resolution.json: Active Quarantine cannot contain release evidence.
invalid.revision-one-released.json: Revision one establishes active protective state.

nonimmediate-predecessor.json.description: A revision greater than one must identify the exact immediately preceding Quarantine revision.

resolution-prior-mismatch.json.description: Release or supersession evidence must identify the same immediate prior revision as the Quarantine envelope.

self-supersession.json.description: A Quarantine series cannot supersede itself as its successor.
